narrative_vs_numbers.point: Revenue YoY accelerated to 22.8% in Q2 FY27, supporting management's upgraded full-year growth target of 26%-27%.
PAT growth rebounded to 28.7% YoY in Q2 FY27 (₹6,367 crore) after a -5.6% decline in Dec 2025.
Management highlights strong asset quality but set aside ₹296 crore in macro provisions as D/E reached 4.08.

bull: Q2 FY27 PAT rose 28.7% YoY to ₹6,367 crore alongside 22.8% revenue growth.
FY27 AUM growth guidance raised from 20%-24% to 26%-27% in Q2 FY27.
Customer franchise addition guidance upgraded to 18-20 million after adding 9.5 million in H1.
bear: Borrowings reached ₹501,982 crore in Sep 2026, pushing D/E ratio to 4.08.
Operating cash flow remained heavily negative at -₹65,790 crore for FY26.
Management created an additional ₹296 crore provision for macroeconomic uncertainty in Q1 FY27.
watch: Delivery on upgraded 26%-27% FY27 growth guidance.
Customer addition trajectory toward the 18-20 million full-year target.
Leverage levels as D/E reached 4.08 in Sep 2026.
